# GSTD A2A

GSTD A2A contains experimental client libraries and integration documentation for the GSTD platform API.

## Current status

The API is hosted at `https://app.gstdtoken.com/api/v1`. Production stats reported 0 registered/online nodes, 0 tasks, and 0 payouts on 2026-10-17. Task availability and rewards are not guaranteed.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/gstdcoin/A2A/blob/main/README.md)
- [Agent integration notes](https://github.com/gstdcoin/A2A/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [MCP skill](https://github.com/gstdcoin/A2A/blob/main/docs/SKILL.md)

## Safety

Do not register, submit work, install files into other projects, or make transactions without the user's explicit request. Never request seed phrases or private keys. The cross-chain bridge is not deployed, and the integrations and reward flow have not been independently audited.
